beats.subline: Tuesday, August 25, 2026 close — stocks rose across the board as falling oil prices eased bond-market pressure ahead of Nvidia's earnings.
beats.body: Brent crude fell below $90 a barrel on hopes for a revival of Strait of Hormuz shipping via new Iran-Oman talks, pulling Treasury yields lower and lifting tech shares; chipmakers snapped a seven-day slide, with Nvidia up roughly 2.5% ahead of Wednesday's earnings report.

beats.headline: Iran and Oman open talks on interim reopening of Strait of Hormuz shipping
beats.body: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met his Omani counterpart Badr Albusaidi in Tehran Tuesday to discuss a temporary joint navigation corridor and a mine-clearing project meant to restore safe passage through the strait, which has been largely paralyzed since early in the war and normally carries about a fifth of the world's oil and LNG exports.

beats.headline: Satellite images show new radar-type structures rising on South China Sea islet
beats.body: Commercial satellite imagery reviewed by Reuters shows construction since March on Yagong Island near Antelope Reef in the Paracels; analysts say the three-pronged structure resembles other Chinese early-warning radar facilities and likely supports what could become China's largest military base in the archipelago.

beats.headline: US resumes lethal strikes on suspected drug boats in eastern Pacific after two-month pause
beats.body: US Southern Command carried out a 'lethal kinetic strike' on a low-profile vessel along established narco-trafficking routes in the eastern Pacific, killing two people; it's the first such strike in roughly two months, bringing the campaign's toll to about 223 killed in 67 strikes since last fall.

beats.headline: Marine Corps accepts first Australian-designed logistics-connector prototype for Indo-Pacific use
beats.body: The Marine Corps Warfighting Laboratory formally accepted the first of two Ancillary Surface Craft prototypes built to move Marines, vehicles and supplies between ships and austere shorelines, a capability the Corps has flagged as central to any future contested-logistics fight in the Indo-Pacific.

beats.headline: Anthropic merges Claude's memory across chat and Claude Cowork
beats.body: Anthropic announced Claude will now carry what it learns in one product into others, with chat and Claude Cowork sharing a unified memory listed under Settings > Memory that users can edit or delete; sensitive topics like health and beliefs stay excluded from memory by default.

beats.headline: Bears activate Elliott and Hicks off PUP, sign Grier, place Sewell on injured reserve
beats.body: The Bears activated linebacker Keyshaun Elliott (back) and safety Elijah Hicks (shin) off the physically-unable-to-perform list Tuesday, signed linebacker Antonio Grier and placed linebacker Nephi Sewell on Reserve/Injured, trimming the PUP list to three players ahead of Saturday's preseason finale at Tennessee.

beats.headline: Byron and Blaney set as co-favorites for Daytona's regular-season finale
beats.body: William Byron shares the best Coke Zero Sugar 400 odds at +850 with Ryan Blaney ahead of Saturday's Daytona race, the regular-season finale before the Chase field is set; Byron has already clinched his playoff berth, and NASCAR is rolling out a lower-downforce aero package for the race with no on-track practice beforehand.

beats.headline: No fresh news on this beat right now
beats.body: No new PCA-specific development from a reputable outlet surfaced within the 72-hour window beyond the June General Assembly and stated clerk transition already reported in prior briefs.
